finding: *** THE CLAIM THIS CORRECTS IS THIS ARCHIVE'S OWN, MADE THE SAME EVENING ***
detail: After reading the 1874 marriage this archive wrote that the next document was "FRIEDERICA'S OWN BIRTH ENTRY in the Szubin birth books, which are online and cover the 1850s." THAT IS WRONG, AND IT IS WRONG FOR A REASON THAT SHOULD HAVE BEEN CHECKED FIRST.

finding: *** PRUSSIAN CIVIL REGISTRATION BEGAN ON 1 OCTOBER 1874 ***
detail: There are no Standesamt books of any kind before that date, anywhere in Prussia. THE PROOF IS SITTING IN THE ARCHIVE'S OWN FIND: the whole 1874 marriage unit for USC Szubin Miasto is "Akta małżeństw nr 1-9" — NINE MARRIAGES FOR THE YEAR — because the office only existed for the last three months of it. Friederica was about twenty in November 1874, so she was born around 1852 and CANNOT HAVE A CIVIL BIRTH ENTRY. A Jewish birth of the 1850s could only ever be in the records of the Jewish religious community.

the test, and it was run with controls first
detail: The portal's TEAM facet lists the archival fonds. Three probes: "Miasto" as a positive control, "Gmina" to find religious-community fonds, and "ydow" — the searchable stem of ŻYDOWSKA, Jewish — for the thing actually wanted.

finding: CONTROL TWO — religious fonds are in this portal and are findable
detail: Gmina returns EXACTLY ONE: **EWANGELICKO-UNIJNA GMINA WYZNANIOWA W SZUBINIE — the Evangelical-Unionist religious community of Szubin, 286 units.** So church-community records for Szubin are digitised, catalogued and reachable. The instrument is not blind to this class of record.

finding: *** AND THE ANSWER: "ydow" RETURNS NOTHING AT ALL ***
detail: No fonds in this portal carries ŻYDOWSKA in its name. There is no Jewish religious community fonds for Szubin here, and none for anywhere else in the Kuyavia-Pomerania corpus either. SZUBIN'S PRE-1874 COVERAGE IN THIS PORTAL IS PROTESTANT AND NOTHING ELSE.

finding: a second check from the other end
detail: Filtering to town SZUBIN with the date facet set to 1852 returns NO REGISTER UNITS AT ALL — only two volunteer person-index cards, Adam Steinberg and Stanisław Kurdelski, both transcriptions rather than scanned books.

finding: *** FRIEDERICA SCHMUL'S BIRTH CANNOT BE FOUND ON THIS PORTAL. ***
detail: Not because it has not been looked for, but because the record class does not exist here. The route this archive proposed a few hours ago is closed, and saying so is the point of writing it down.

WHETHER THE SZUBIN JEWISH REGISTERS SURVIVE AT ALL. This is a statement about one portal's holdings, not about the world. Jewish community registers for Posen towns can sit unscanned at the state archive, at the Jewish Historical Institute in Warsaw, or in the JRI-Poland indexes, and some were destroyed. NONE OF THOSE HAS BEEN ASKED. The Bydgoszcz archive answered one letter in eight days and is the obvious place to ask a second time — it holds USC Szubin Miasto and would know what else it has for the town.
